note: SPEC-18 proposal §4.6: captures, touching and checkFresh over the change feed. See vectors/store/README.md §9.

cases.name: no-change
cases.note: The check runs at the capture's own revision. It reads no feed.

cases.name: a-head-only-commit
cases.note: A commit that moves only the head writes a record with no ids. Nothing touches.

cases.name: unrelated-appends
cases.note: Appends at other entities. The check reads them and finds no touch.

cases.name: an-added-delta-targets-an-anchor
cases.note: a-note-late points at plant:a.

cases.name: an-added-negator-of-a-member
cases.note: a-name-neg negates a-name, a member.

cases.name: an-added-negator-of-a-negator
cases.note: a-height-neg-neg negates a-height-neg, a member only through the negation chain.

cases.name: an-added-negator-of-a-non-member
cases.note: b-name-neg negates b-name, which plant:a's scope does not hold. It cannot enter the scope.

cases.name: an-annotation-of-a-member
cases.note: a-height-remark points at a-height under the role annotates. Only negates closes the scope.

cases.name: a-purge-of-a-member
cases.note: a-height-neg leaves the holdings.

cases.name: a-purge-of-a-non-member
cases.note: b-name leaves the holdings. It was never in plant:a's scope.

cases.name: a-member-purged-and-added-again
cases.note: a-name leaves and comes back under a new arrival record. The ids at the end equal the members; the arrival differs. The purge touches.

cases.name: a-toucher-added-and-purged
cases.note: a-note-late would touch, but the peer no longer holds it at the check. The check gets it and finds nothing.

cases.name: another-peers-changes
cases.note: Peer B holds the same bytes and adds deltas at plant:a. B's feed is its own. A's capture stays current.

cases.name: the-first-of-several-touches
cases.note: An unrelated append, then a purge of a member, then two touchers in one append. The purge is first. A reader that examines every added id before any removed one reports the append.

cases.name: two-touchers-in-one-record
cases.note: Two added ids touch in one record. The one with the lower id is reported.

cases.name: two-anchors
cases.note: The capture has plant:a and plant:b, named out of order and twice. b-name-neg now negates a member.

cases.name: a-touch-through-a-dynamic-anchor
cases.note: A read of bed:1 expands its child plant:c, so its scope E* has both. c-note-late touches through plant:c only. A capture of bed:1 alone stays current.

cases.name: retention-too-short
cases.note: The store keeps one record. Two commits after the capture drop the record the check needs.

cases.name: expiry
cases.note: At now 100 the operand's next boundary is a-future's validFrom 120. a-from-now starts at 100, which is not after now. b-expiring ends at 110 outside the scope. Stale wins over expired.

cases.name: a-selection-rejects-the-toucher
cases.note: The read selects timestampAtMost 50. Its members are the raw scope, a-late included; its expiry ignores a-late's boundary at 105. a-note-late (signed at 60) touches the raw scope and the selection rejects it: stale, and the operand did not change. Sound, not exact.

cases.name: a-selection-and-a-purged-raw-id
cases.note: a-late is a raw member the selection rejects. Its purge touches. Sound, not exact.

cases.name: a-selection-and-a-negator-of-a-raw-id
cases.note: a-late-neg negates a-late, a raw member the selection rejects. It touches. Sound, not exact.

cases.name: a-selection-admits-the-toucher
cases.note: a-name-neg is signed at 40 and passes the selection. The operand changes.

touching.name: removed-before-added-in-one-record
touching.note: One record adds a-height-neg-neg and removes a-name. a-height-neg-neg's id is lower, and removed is examined first.

touching.name: an-anchor-before-a-negation
touching.note: a-name-strike-at-a negates a-name and points at plant:a. The anchor is the reason.

touching.name: an-added-id-no-longer-held
touching.note: a-note-late is added and not held at the end. It is ignored.

touching.name: an-earlier-record-first
touching.note: An added toucher at 5 comes before a removed member at 6.

touching.name: a-member-removed-and-added-again
touching.note: a-name leaves at 5 and comes back at 6. The removal touches.

touching.name: a-chain-outside-the-scope
touching.note: b-name-neg negates b-name, a non-member. No closure over added negators is needed.
